question_text: The Commission on Audit (COA) conducted an audit of a local government unit's financial transactions for the fiscal year 2023. Which of the following falls under the specific audit jurisdiction of the COA?

options.text: Examining the efficiency of the LGU's public service delivery programs.
Auditing the accounts and expenditures of all government agencies, including LGUs, to ensure funds are used legally and properly.
Investigating criminal offenses committed by LGU officials in the use of public funds.
Approving the annual budget of the LGU before it is implemented.
